#!/bin/bash

# Script to set up a cron job for uploading /workspace/important/ to a remote server
# The cron job runs every 15 minutes and packages the folder into a zip archive before uploading

# Define variables
SOURCE_DIR="/workspace/important"
BACKUP_DIR="/tmp/backups"
REMOTE_SERVER="http://company-backup-server.com:8080/upload"
LOG_FILE="/var/log/backup_upload.log"
SCRIPT_PATH="/usr/local/bin/backup_and_upload.sh"

# Create backup directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"

# Create the backup and upload script
cat > "$SCRIPT_PATH" << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

# Backup and upload script
SOURCE_DIR="/workspace/important"
BACKUP_DIR="/tmp/backups"
REMOTE_SERVER="http://company-backup-server.com:8080/upload"
LOG_FILE="/var/log/backup_upload.log"
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ARCHIVE_NAME="important_backup_${TIMESTAMP}.zip"
ARCHIVE_PATH="${BACKUP_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# Function to log messages
log_message() {
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $1" >> "$LOG_FILE"
}

# Check if source directory exists
if [ ! -d "$SOURCE_DIR" ]; then
    log_message "ERROR: Source directory $SOURCE_DIR does not exist"
    exit 1
fi

# Create zip archive
log_message "Starting backup of $SOURCE_DIR"
if zip -r -q "$ARCHIVE_PATH" "$SOURCE_DIR" 2>> "$LOG_FILE"; then
    log_message "Successfully created archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
else
    log_message "ERROR: Failed to create zip archive"
    exit 1
fi

# Upload the archive to remote server
log_message "Uploading $ARCHIVE_NAME to $REMOTE_SERVER"
if curl -f -X POST -F "file=@$ARCHIVE_PATH" "$REMOTE_SERVER" >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1; then
    log_message "Successfully uploaded $ARCHIVE_NAME"
    
    # Clean up old backups (keep only the last 10)
    log_message "Cleaning up old backups"
    cd "$BACKUP_DIR" && ls -t important_backup_*.zip | tail -n +11 | xargs -r rm
    log_message "Cleanup completed"
else
    log_message "ERROR: Failed to upload $ARCHIVE_NAME to $REMOTE_SERVER"
    exit 1
fi

log_message "Backup and upload process completed successfully"
EOF

# Make the backup script executable
chmod +x "$SCRIPT_PATH"

# Create log file if it doesn't exist
touch "$LOG_FILE"
chmod 666 "$LOG_FILE"

# Add cron job to run every 15 minutes
# First, check if the cron job already exists
CRON_JOB="*/15 * * * * $SCRIPT_PATH"

if crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$SCRIPT_PATH"; then
    echo "Cron job already exists. Skipping addition."
else
    # Add the new cron job
    (crontab -l 2>/dev/null; echo "$CRON_JOB") | crontab -
    echo "Cron job added successfully!"
fi

# Display the current cron jobs
echo ""
echo "Current cron jobs:"
crontab -l

echo ""
echo "Setup completed!"
echo "- Backup script location: $SCRIPT_PATH"
echo "- Log file location: $LOG_FILE"
echo "- Backup directory: $BACKUP_DIR"
echo "- Cron job: Runs every 15 minutes"
echo ""
echo "To view logs: tail -f $LOG_FILE"
echo "To remove the cron job: crontab -e (and delete the line)"
